approval_statement: ok you can now proceed with the new 8 task

tasks.question: Can a benchmark-isolated launch reproduce the saved effective non-target input and survive monitor publication failures?
tasks.scope: One input-fidelity and monitor qualification, at most 45 minutes. Preserve CLI/model/effort/task/source and the saved developer catalog; never edit the saved reference or global user configuration. Add fail-first checks for missing monitoring directories, first-publication failure and exact cancellation. At most one separately admitted read-only subscription diagnostic, 60-second wall and 100,000 recorded-raw tripwire, only if actual input delivery cannot be checked locally. Stop with a setup result if fidelity is unavailable; no feature run hidden here.

tasks.question: Does the complete B feedback/handoff inverse change actual work and cost when non-target inputs match?
tasks.scope: One fresh A-on/B-off/C-on visual initial-author episode only if R13 qualifies; unchanged frozen B group, actual results and custody. Compare with the fixed saved all-on visual author. Maximum 15 minutes and 3,000,000 recorded raw, one attempt, no automatic repair or replacement. Preserve all failures/tails; judge action/state activation before total. Distinct new observation, not reopening R03.

tasks.question: Does the A+B joint inverse change actual work and cost with the same qualified input boundary?
tasks.scope: One fresh A-off/B-off/C-on visual initial-author episode only if R13 qualifies; exact existing joint factor set and fixed saved reference. Maximum 15 minutes and 3,000,000 recorded raw, one attempt, no repair/replacement. Compare with R14 when valid to separate conditional A from B without adding an ordinary control. No A-only or native-custody rerun.

tasks.question: Does the strongest qualified B or A+B reversal persist through complete required workflows?
tasks.scope: One selection decision using R14/R15 and their non-target/mechanism gates. Only if eligible, exactly three modified complete workflows of that one already-defined arm, concurrent with separate checkouts/artifacts, no ordinary control or replacement. Reviews/fixes/integration included. Maximum 90-minute walls; prospective raw tripwires and subscription feasibility frozen before admission. No eligible arm means a no-batch result; no added screen.

tasks.question: Are all newly admitted qualification, author and workflow observations valid for their declared contrasts?
tasks.scope: One existing-core source/input/activation/distinct-response and missing-tail audit of every actual R13–R16 admission, including failures and skipped identities. No native accounting re-audit of old baselines, new validator framework or generated replacement.

tasks.question: Does reduced author work shift cost into later review, repair or integration in the qualified treatment?
tasks.scope: One complete stage/work-trigger offset table for actual R16 workflows and the fixed saved reference. All required work and costs remain. If R16 is absent/incomplete, report unavailable inference without new generation or imputation.

tasks.question: What amount of the accepted historical gap is supported by the qualified joint evidence?
tasks.scope: One synthesis of R17/R18 and saved R07 overlap against the unchanged historical denominator, separating package contrast, historical transfer, interactions and offsets. Report supported amount/residual or precise missing identification; no new experiment or original-saving revalidation.

tasks.question: Does the finite extension support the requested answer, or require another explicit zero-counter decision?
tasks.scope: One final source/evidence/arithmetic/coverage review of R13–R19 and the affected register entries. Publish supported answer or exact case (1)/(2) request at zero. No hidden experiments, reopened task or self-approved increase.
